title: SAGE: Sustainable Agent-Guided Expert-tuning for Culturally Attuned Translation in Low-Resource Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Blinded qualitative study with native speakers evaluating the translation of community dialogues to assess the appropriate use of hierarchical honorifics, context-dependent pronouns, and cultural subtleties.

Quantitative evaluation using BLEU-4 and COMET-22 metrics to measure neural machine translation performance disparities across seven low-resource Southeast Asian languages compared to general-purpose, high-resource baselines.
